Check: The account field label uses the Vietnamese term defined by the screen's requirement, not an English alternative.
Expected Result: Label reads "Email"; "Username" is not displayed.

Check: The submit button uses a Vietnamese action label consistent with the rest of the interface.
Expected Result: Button reads "Đăng nhập"; "Sign In" is not displayed.

Check: The page heading text describes the current screen, not another screen.
Expected Result: Heading reads "Đăng nhập"; it does not say "Đăng Ký".

Check: A positive submit action uses the standard blue action colour.
Expected Result: Button background is blue (design-token blue), not red.

Element: Primary "Đặt lại mật khẩu" and secondary "← Quay lại" buttons
Check: Primary and secondary actions are visually distinguishable; the positive primary action uses blue.
Expected Result: "Đặt lại mật khẩu" is blue; "← Quay lại" does not use the same fill colour as the primary button (e.g. white/grey background with a border).
Review note: P06: Định nghĩa cụ thể 'clearly secondary'.

Check: Each page has exactly one `<h1>` describing the page; section headings use `<h2>`.
Expected Result: Every screen has exactly one `<h1>` (no page with zero or multiple `<h1>`), and its text matches the screen.

Check: Typography is consistent across the flow: same font family and same size/weight for headings of the same level.
Expected Result: Computed font-family is identical on every screen; same-level headings have equal font-size/font-weight.
Review note: Review: Bỏ ngưỡng 'body ≥ 14px' do AI tự đặt, không có trong spec.

Element: Password-rules hint "Yêu cầu: Tối thiểu 8 ký tự..."
Check: Secondary help text is readable: at least 12px and a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
Expected Result: Computed font-size is at least 12px; DevTools contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1; the text is not light grey on white.

Check: The authentication cards share the same width, horizontal centring, and padding.
Expected Result: All auth cards have the same max-width (for example 448px), are horizontally centred, and use the same inner padding.

Check: Form fields are aligned consistently: labels above inputs, inputs the same width, equal vertical spacing.
Expected Result: Labels sit above their inputs and are left-aligned; all inputs share the same width; vertical gaps between fields are equal.

Check: The read-only email is visually distinguishable from editable fields while keeping the same form geometry.
Expected Result: The email field has a grey background and the same height/border/radius as the editable fields.
Review note: P06: Chỉ kiểm visual; hành vi read-only ở IA-02-16.

Check: Header/footer keep a consistent height and position; the main content is not overlapped at 100% zoom.
Expected Result: Header and footer have the same height/position on every screen; no content is hidden behind them.

Check: A long display name does not break the header layout.
Expected Result: A 60-character name wraps or truncates inside the greeting area; it does not overlap "Thoát" or push the nav off-screen.
Review note: Review: Header greeting hiện ở mọi trang khi đã login, không chỉ Profile.

Element: Tab order from the first field
Check: Keyboard Tab order follows the visual top-to-bottom, left-to-right order; the submit button is not focused before the fields.
Expected Result: Tab sequence is Email → Password → "Quên mật khẩu?" → "Sign In" → "Đăng ký ngay"; no `tabIndex` jump to "Sign In" first.

Element: Tab order through the profile form
Check: Disabled fields are skipped and the remaining controls follow the visual order.
Expected Result: Tab sequence is Họ Tên → Số điện thoại → Địa chỉ giao hàng → Cập nhật; the disabled email is skipped; focus is never trapped.

Check: Every interactive element shows a visible focus indicator when reached by keyboard.
Expected Result: Each focused element has a visible outline/ring/box-shadow with at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colours; focus is never lost.

Check: The layout remains usable when the browser is zoomed to 200%.
Expected Result: No horizontal scrollbar; no text or control is clipped; forms and buttons remain visible and operable.

Check: Vietnamese names with diacritics are displayed correctly everywhere the name appears.
Expected Result: After saving Họ Tên "Nguyễn Lê Thế Vinh", the header shows "Chào, Nguyễn Lê Thế Vinh" and the Profile field shows the same text; no missing/broken diacritics or garbled characters.
Review note: Ý 1 (tên tiếng Việt). Tên rất dài đã có ở IA-01-13 nên không tách item riêng.
Why AI missed: (c) Đặc thù của SUT: AI chỉ dùng dữ liệu ASCII ("Test User") có sẵn trong screenshot; không nghĩ tới dữ liệu tiếng Việt thật của SUT.

Element: Whole page at 320 CSS px width
Check: Content reflows at a 320 CSS px wide viewport without loss of content or function (WCAG 1.4.10).
Expected Result: In DevTools device toolbar at 320 px width: no horizontal scrollbar; header items do not overlap; every field and button is visible and usable.
Review note: Ý 10 (zoom 200%). Zoom 200% đã có ở IA-01-17, item này kiểm reflow ở 320 px.
Why AI missed: (b) Giới hạn của model: AI chỉ thấy screenshot desktop một kích thước nên không xét viewport hẹp.

Check: User-entered name is shown as plain text and never rendered as HTML.
Expected Result: Register/Profile with Họ Tên `x`: the header shows the literal text `Chào, x`, not a bold "x"; no HTML or script from the name is executed.
Review note: Ý 1 (tên chứa x).
Why AI missed: (b) Giới hạn của model: Cách render (`dangerouslySetInnerHTML`) không thấy được trong screenshot tĩnh; AI cũng không thử dữ liệu chứa HTML.

Check: Every required field has a `*` immediately next to its label.
Expected Result: On Login, Register, FP step 1/2, and Profile, every required label shows `*`; optional fields do not.

Check: Each input has a visible, programmatically associated label; clicking the label focuses the input; no field relies on its placeholder as the only label.
Expected Result: Every input has a `<label for="...">` matching its `id`; clicking the label moves focus; placeholders are supplementary only.

Check: Every email field uses `type="email"` and native HTML5 validation blocks malformed addresses.
Expected Result: DOM `type="email"` on all three fields; entering `abc` and submitting shows the browser's email-format validation; no request is sent.

Check: Every password field uses `type="password"` and masks typed characters.
Expected Result: DOM `type="password"` on Login, Register, and FP step 2; characters are masked in all states.

Check: Registration requires a confirmation-password field and rejects a mismatch before creating the account.
Expected Result: The field exists; with mismatched values an error is shown and logging in with the submitted email/password fails; matching values allow submit.
Review note: P06: Đổi 'no account is created' thành cách kiểm trên UI.

Check: Password-strength validation accepts a valid FR-01 password and rejects weak ones with a message naming the missing rule.
Expected Result: `Abc12345!` is accepted; `abc12345`, `Abcdefgh`, `Abc12345` are rejected.
Review note: P06: Chỉ kiểm accept/reject; nội dung message chuyển sang IA-04-05.

Check: Registering with an already-used email is rejected with a clear error and does not create a duplicate account.
Expected Result: Submit `test@eshop.com`: registration is rejected and the user stays on Register (no redirect to Login).
Review note: Review: Bỏ 'user count unchanged' vì không kiểm được trên UI. | P06: Chỉ kiểm reject; nội dung message chuyển sang IA-04-06.

Check: Login errors are displayed above the submit button, not below it.
Expected Result: Error banner is above "Sign In" in the DOM and visually; it is not rendered after the button/link.

Check: Step 1 shows a clear "Bước 1 / 2" indicator.
Expected Result: "Bước 1 / 2" (or equivalent) is visible before submitting.

Check: Step 2 shows a clear "Bước 2 / 2" indicator.
Expected Result: "Bước 2 / 2" (or equivalent) is visible.

Check: The OTP is exactly 6 digits; the OTP input accepts 6 digits and rejects 5 or 7.
Expected Result: OTP shown is 6 digits; the input accepts exactly 6 digits; 5-digit and 7-digit values are rejected.
Review note: P06: Chỉ kiểm độ dài OTP; cách trình bày info box ở IA-04-08.

Check: The reset form requires a confirmation-password field and rejects a mismatch before changing the password.
Expected Result: Field exists; mismatch shows an error and the password is unchanged; matching values allow reset.

Check: Step-2 OTP/password errors are shown inline above the submit button, not through a blocking `alert()`.
Expected Result: The error appears above "Đặt lại mật khẩu"; no `window.alert` dialog opens.
Review note: P06: Chỉ kiểm vị trí và kiểu hiển thị; nội dung lỗi OTP ở IA-04-09.

Check: Phone validation accepts a leading 0 with 10–11 digits and rejects all other formats.
Expected Result: `0912345678` and `09123456789` are accepted; `912345678`, `091234567`, `091234567890`, `abc` are rejected; a valid value persists after save and reload.
Review note: P06: Bỏ 'with a message'; nội dung message ở IA-04-12.

Check: Email is read-only and cannot be changed through the profile form.
Expected Result: Field is disabled; no edit is possible; after changing other fields, saving, and reloading, email remains the original.

Check: Empty required fields trigger native HTML5 validation and block submission.
Expected Result: Every required input has the `required` attribute; submitting empty focuses the first invalid field and sends no request.

Check: Email and password fields expose correct `autocomplete` hints for password managers.
Expected Result: In the DOM: email fields use `autocomplete="email"`; Login password uses `current-password`; Register/FP new passwords use `new-password`.
Review note: P06: Bỏ 'browser offers save/fill' vì phụ thuộc password manager.

Check: Emails that differ only in letter case or surrounding spaces are treated as the same account.
Expected Result: Register with "Test@EShop.com " (uppercase + trailing space) is rejected as a duplicate of test@eshop.com; Login with " TEST@eshop.com" and the correct password succeeds.
Review note: Ý 2 (email viết hoa / có khoảng trắng).
Why AI missed: (b) Giới hạn của model: AI chỉ xét trùng email theo chuỗi giống hệt; biến thể hoa/thường và khoảng trắng cần dữ liệu test động.

Check: The new-password rule is shown before the user types, consistent with Register.
Expected Result: Step 2 shows the FR-01 password rule near "Mật khẩu mới" before any input, with the same wording as the Register hint.
Review note: Ý 3 (password rule hiện trước khi gõ). Register đã có hint nên item kiểm ở FP step 2.
Why AI missed: (a) Prompt chưa nhắc tới: Inventory và prompt chỉ nêu hint ở Register; AI không so sánh tính nhất quán giữa các màn hình.

Check: The OTP field accepts a pasted value.
Expected Result: Copying the OTP from the info box and pasting it (Ctrl+V) fills the field completely; paste is not blocked; surrounding spaces from the copy do not cause an error.
Review note: Ý 4 (paste vào OTP).
Why AI missed: (b) Giới hạn của model: Hành vi clipboard không thấy được trong screenshot tĩnh.

Check: A long email in the read-only field is fully readable.
Expected Result: With a 40+ character email, the full address is visible in the field or available on hover/tooltip; it is not cut off without a way to read it.
Review note: Ý 6 (email read-only rõ ràng). Phần visual/behavior đã có ở IA-01-11 và IA-02-16, item này kiểm email dài.
Why AI missed: (b) Giới hạn của model: Screenshot chỉ có email ngắn (test@eshop.com) nên AI không xét trường hợp email dài.

Check: The logged-out header shows the Login and Register links and hides the authenticated controls.
Expected Result: "Đăng nhập" and "Đăng ký" are visible; "Chào, {name}" and "Thoát" are absent on Login, Register, and Forgot Password.

Check: The logged-in header shows the profile greeting and Logout and hides the Login/Register links.
Expected Result: "Chào, {name}" and "Thoát" are visible; "Đăng nhập" and "Đăng ký" are absent.

Check: The navigation item for the current screen is visually highlighted.
Expected Result: On `/login`, `/register` and `/profile`, the matching nav item has a visibly different style (colour, underline or background) from the other nav items.
Review note: P06: Định nghĩa 'active style' bằng phần nhìn thấy; `aria-current` không bắt buộc vì FR-23 chỉ nói 'highlight'.

Check: The cart link shows a badge with the number of items in the cart.
Expected Result: After adding 1 product to the cart, the "Giỏ hàng" link shows a badge with 1 on every G1 screen.
Review note: P06: Không chọn 'hiện 0' hay 'ẩn khi trống' (đều là đoán); kiểm với 1 sản phẩm.

Check: The logout control uses the label "Đăng xuất", not "Thoát".
Expected Result: Button text is "Đăng xuất".

Check: The logo returns the user to Home from any G1 screen.
Expected Result: From Login, Register, Forgot Password and Profile, clicking "EShop" navigates to `/` and the product list renders.
Review note: P06: Screen khớp với 'from any G1 screen'.

Check: The forgot-password link opens Forgot Password step 1.
Expected Result: URL becomes `/forgot-password`; step 1 form renders; the browser does not perform a full page reload.
Review note: Review: Yêu cầu 'không full reload' là heuristic SPA, không thuộc FR-03.

Check: The registration link opens the Register screen.
Expected Result: URL becomes `/register`; the Register form renders.

Check: The login link opens the Login screen.
Expected Result: URL becomes `/login`; the Login form renders.

Check: Step 1 provides a visible control that returns to Login.
Expected Result: A link/button labelled "Quay lại đăng nhập" is visible and navigates to `/login`.

Check: The back control returns to step 1 without losing the email already entered.
Expected Result: Clicking returns to the step-1 form; the email field still contains the address; no data is lost.

Check: Refreshing the page on step 2 does not lose the user's progress.
Expected Result: After refresh, the user is still on step 2 and the email is preserved.
Review note: P06: Bỏ phần Back. BÁC đề xuất 'Refresh → step 1, email trống' của P06: đó là hành vi lỗi hiện tại, dùng làm Expected thì item luôn Passed.

Check: A successful registration navigates to Login.
Expected Result: After a valid submit, URL is `/login` and the Login form renders; the user is not auto-logged in.
Review note: Review: Bỏ 'success indication' vì trùng IA-04-04.

Check: A successful login navigates to Home or the originally requested page.
Expected Result: URL is `/`; the header switches to the logged-in state; the Login form is no longer shown.
Review note: Review: FR-02 không quy định trang đích sau khi login. | P06: Chốt một đích `/` (app không có return URL).

Check: Logging out clears the session and switches the header to the logged-out state.
Expected Result: Token is removed; header shows Login/Register again; the profile form and order data are no longer accessible.
Review note: Review: FR-23 chỉ quy định nhãn nút logout, không quy định hành vi.

Check: An unauthenticated visit to `/profile` does not render the profile form.
Expected Result: Visiting `/profile` while logged out redirects to `/login`; no profile form or order data is shown.
Review note: P06: Chốt một kết quả: redirect `/login`.

Check: An authenticated user visiting `/login` is redirected away from the login form.
Expected Result: Visiting `/login` while logged in redirects to `/`; the Login form is not shown.
Review note: Review: FR-02 không yêu cầu redirect khi đã login. | P06: Chốt một đích `/`.

Check: An authenticated user visiting `/register` is redirected away from the registration form.
Expected Result: Visiting `/register` while logged in redirects to `/`; the Register form is not shown.
Review note: Ý 8 (đã login vào lại /login). `/login` đã có ở IA-03-17, item này kiểm `/register`.
Why AI missed: (a) Prompt chưa nhắc tới: AI chỉ tạo item cho `/login` (IA-03-17), bỏ qua route `/register` tương tự.

Element: "← Quay lại" then "Lấy mã OTP" again
Check: Going back and requesting a new OTP replaces the old one.
Expected Result: After "← Quay lại" and requesting again, the info box shows a new OTP; the new OTP works and the previous OTP is rejected.
Review note: Ý 5 (bấm ← Quay lại giữa step 1 và 2). Việc giữ email đã có ở IA-03-11, item này kiểm OTP cũ/mới.
Why AI missed: (b) Giới hạn của model: Luồng nhiều bước (quay lại rồi request lại) không suy ra được từ screenshot tĩnh.

Check: Wrong credentials produce a visible error that does not reveal whether the email exists or which field is wrong.
Expected Result: Banner appears; text is generic ("Đăng nhập thất bại...") and does not say "email not found" or "wrong password".

Check: After repeated failures lock the account, the UI shows a lock message distinguishable from the wrong-password message, without revealing which credential is wrong.
Expected Result: A lock message (e.g. 'Tài khoản đã bị khóa. Vui lòng thử lại sau.') is shown instead of the generic banner; no email/password detail is leaked.
Review note: Review: Bỏ yêu cầu countdown / '30 giây': FR-02 không yêu cầu (xem inventory-review R2). Countdown chuyển thành ý usability.

Check: The previous login error is cleared or updated when the user edits a field or retries.
Expected Result: Editing email/password removes the old error; a new submit shows only the current result; no stale error remains.

Check: A successful registration shows a visible success message.
Expected Result: After a valid submit, a success message (e.g. "Đăng ký thành công") is visible to the user.
Review note: Review: FR-01 chỉ yêu cầu redirect sang Login, không yêu cầu success message. | P06: Bỏ clause redirect (đã có ở IA-03-13); không thêm 'thời gian hiển thị tối thiểu' vì spec không có.

Check: The weak-password message accurately lists the rule that failed and matches the actual validation.
Expected Result: Message names the missing uppercase/lowercase/digit/special requirement and matches what the validator actually enforces; it stays visible until corrected.
Review note: Review: Bỏ chi tiết 'validator requires a space': AI lấy từ file ngoài input (report/g1-dieu-tra-lech-spec.md); checklist không đoán trước kết quả. | P06: Item duy nhất kiểm nội dung message của password rule.

Check: The duplicate-email error message is human-readable and does not expose raw DB/API errors.
Expected Result: Banner says the email is already registered (e.g., "Email đã được sử dụng"); no `SQLITE_CONSTRAINT`, SQL, or stack trace is shown.
Review note: P06: Chỉ kiểm nội dung message (trùng scenario với IA-02-07).

Check: An unknown email produces a generic, non-enumerating message and does not use a blocking `alert()`.
Expected Result: Inline message says the request could not be completed / check the email; it does not say "User not found"; no `window.alert` dialog.

Check: After requesting an OTP, the screen clearly presents it as an informational/success state.
Expected Result: The OTP info box is styled as info/success (not as an error) and stays visible while the user types the OTP.
Review note: Review: Bỏ 'message identifies the email' do AI tự thêm, không có trong spec. | P06: Chỉ kiểm cách trình bày.

Check: A wrong OTP produces a specific error and keeps the entered values so the user can retry.
Expected Result: Message says the OTP is invalid/expired; the OTP and new-password fields are not cleared; the user can retry.
Review note: P06: Chỉ kiểm nội dung lỗi + giữ dữ liệu (vị trí ở IA-02-14).

Check: A successful reset confirms that the password changed before or while redirecting to Login.
Expected Result: A visible success message ("Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công") is shown; the app then navigates to `/login`; the old password no longer works.

Check: Saving the profile gives visible confirmation and reflects the new values.
Expected Result: A success toast/inline message appears; the form shows the saved values after reload; the save is not silent.

Check: Profile errors are specific and actionable.
Expected Result: An invalid phone shows a message naming the rule (e.g. "Số điện thoại phải bắt đầu bằng 0 và có 10–11 chữ số"); a failed save shows a message more specific than "Lỗi cập nhật".
Review note: P06: Chỉ kiểm nội dung message (accept/reject ở IA-02-15).

Check: The empty order history uses an icon/illustration plus a friendly message, per FR-24.
Expected Result: At least one icon/illustration is visible with the message "Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào."; the panel is not text-only.
Review note: P06: BÁC đề xuất xóa của P06: item có căn cứ FR-24 (empty state phải có icon) và nằm trên màn hình Profile thuộc G1.

Check: Clicking submit immediately shows a loading/disabled state and prevents duplicate submissions.
Expected Result: With DevTools Network throttled to Slow 3G, the submit button becomes disabled or shows a spinner before the request completes; a second click sends no extra request.
Review note: P06: Định nghĩa 'immediately' = trước khi request xong, quan sát bằng throttling.

Check: Error and success messages are announced to assistive technology.
Expected Result: In the DOM / Accessibility tree: error containers have `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"`; success containers have `role="status"` or `aria-live="polite"`.
Review note: P06: Bỏ 'screen reader announces' vì phụ thuộc AT/browser.

Check: When the API is unreachable or returns 5xx, the form shows a human-readable failure and keeps the user's input.
Expected Result: Message says the server/network failed and to try again; no raw JSON/stack; entered values remain; a retry is possible.

Check: The OTP in the info box can be selected and copied.
Expected Result: The OTP digits can be selected with the mouse/keyboard and copied; the copied text is only the code (or the code plus the label, documented).
Review note: Ý 5 (copy OTP).
Why AI missed: (b) Giới hạn của model: Khả năng chọn/copy chữ không thấy được trong screenshot tĩnh.

Check: After saving a new name, the header greeting updates without a reload.
Expected Result: Change Họ Tên and click "Cập nhật": the header shows "Chào, {new name}" immediately, without reloading the page.
Review note: Ý 7 (save xong reload còn data). Việc dữ liệu còn sau reload đã có ở IA-04-11/IA-02-15, item này kiểm header cập nhật ngay.
Why AI missed: (b) Giới hạn của model: Đồng bộ giữa form và header là hành vi động, không thấy được trong screenshot.

Check: Double-clicking "Lấy mã OTP" does not leave the user with an invalid OTP.
Expected Result: After a fast double click, the OTP shown in the info box is accepted on step 2 (only one OTP is issued, or the shown OTP is the latest).
Review note: Ý 9 (double submit). Double submit chung đã có ở IA-04-16, item này kiểm hậu quả riêng với OTP.
Why AI missed: (c) Đặc thù của SUT: Rủi ro riêng của SUT: mỗi request ghi đè `reset_token`, nên OTP hiển thị có thể đã bị thay.
